warrant_soundness.evidence: argument-map.json > argument_units[arg-01..arg-03]: arg-01 connects the participant-data requirements to the need to anchor the instrument in TOR 5.6; arg-02 connects the evaluation uses of the data dimensions to a concise statement of instrument scope; arg-03 connects the sample letter's decision structure to separating the high-level purpose from the attached full questionnaire. None merely repeats its claim.

mece_coverage.evidence: argument-map.json > governing_thought_components and argument_units[*].supports: the three non-duplicative components cover (1) the TOR/project basis, (2) the instrument's purpose and scope, and (3) the requested approval before use; together they partition the governing thought without substantive overlap.

application_grounded.evidence: argument-map.json > argument_units[arg-01].application_to_design, [arg-02].application_to_design, and [arg-03].application_to_design: each design instruction follows its own warrant respectively by establishing the TOR context, summarising scope without reproducing questions, and placing the full instrument in the attachment before requesting approval.

section_job.evidence: letter-draft.md:11-17 links the engagement and TOR 5.6 to preparation of the evaluation form, then asks the Department to approve that form before use; it does not drift into later evaluation results or system-wide evaluation detail excluded by the contract.

audience_decision_value.evidence: letter-draft.md:13-17 gives the decision-maker the instrument's purpose, high-level data scope, attachment locator, and the exact action requested; consultant workflow is not foregrounded beyond the context needed for the decision.

evidence_payload.evidence: letter-draft.md:11 establishes the project/contract/TOR basis; line 13 identifies participant feedback, satisfaction, perception/understanding, quantitative information, qualitative suggestions, and their evaluation/improvement use; lines 15-17 identify the attached instrument and approval action. This is sufficient payload at the contract's short-letter altitude.

causal_logic.evidence: letter-draft.md:11-17 progresses without reversal from contractual context, to the evaluation information the form is intended to collect and use, to submission of that form for approval before deployment.

argument_fidelity.evidence: letter-draft.md:11 verbalizes arg-01; line 13 verbalizes arg-02; lines 15-17 verbalize arg-03. The quantitative/qualitative sentence is a contract-required elaboration of arg-02's approved data-scope unit, not a new governing claim, and no argument unit is silently dropped.

reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: letter-draft.md:1-23 contains only conventional letter fields, audience-facing prose, the attachment reference, closing, and explicit fill-in placeholders; it contains no source paths, prompt residue, internal artifact references, drafting commentary, or fake diagrams.

terminology_agency.evidence: letter-draft.md:11-17 assigns the technical preparation to 'คณะที่ปรึกษา', the submission/request to 'บริษัทฯ', and the approval decision to the Department. The local connector issue at line 13 is recorded as finding ER-002 but does not destabilize actor identity or the governing request.

source_fidelity.evidence: Against writing-contract.json only, letter-draft.md:11-17 preserves TOR 5.6, participant opinions, satisfaction, perception/understanding, quantitative information with qualitative suggestions, use for evaluation/improvement, and approval before use; it introduces no scores, respondent characteristics, analysis methods, future results, or premature endorsement. The 'และ/หรือ' distinction at line 13 is a localized minor finding (ER-002), not loss of the letter's governing substance.

form_readability.evidence: letter-draft.md:1-23 follows a readable formal-letter sequence: date/reference fields, subject, recipient, attachment, contractual context, proposed substance, requested action, formal closing, and signatory fields. The missing project-name slot in the context paragraph is separately located as minor finding ER-001.

letter_profile.evidence: letter-draft.md:5 states the purpose; lines 7 and 11 provide recipient-relevant context; lines 15-17 state the requested action; lines 13 and 15 distinguish the responsible technical and submitting actors; and 'ก่อนนำไปใช้' at line 15 supplies the applicable timing/next-step condition.

findings.location: letter-draft.md:11, phrase 'โครงการ “พัฒนาชุดข้อมูล องค์ความรู้ ความเสี่ยง และผลกระทบจากการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศของประเทศไทย”'
findings.issue: The project name is hard-coded in the contractual-context paragraph even though writing-contract.json > report_specific_rules[5] requires a fill-in slot for the project name. This is a local template-readiness issue; the name itself is consistent with the contracted attachment title.
findings.disposition: accepted_for_human_review; replace the contextual project title with [ชื่อโครงการ] before issue if the letter is intended to remain a fill-in template

findings.location: letter-draft.md:13, phrase 'การรับรู้และความเข้าใจ'
findings.issue: The draft uses the conjunction 'และ', while writing-contract.json > inclusions[1] and required_concepts[2] preserve the distinction as 'การรับรู้หรือความเข้าใจ'. Both concepts remain present, so the approval request is unchanged, but the connector should be confirmed against the intended instrument scope.
findings.disposition: accepted_for_human_review; prefer 'การรับรู้หรือความเข้าใจ' before issue unless the attached instrument expressly measures both as cumulative dimensions
